headline: 135 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Little Giant Fire in WA, threatening 6,010 structures.

active_threats.name: Little Giant
active_threats.narrative: The Little Giant Fire in Chelan County, WA has burned 136,285 acres and is 10% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **6,010 structures threatened**. 2,024 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 11 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind (W) is not currently aligned toward Leavenworth city, the nearest community of size, 30 miles away.

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over FL: Miami city, Port St. Lucie city, Cape Coral city, Fort Lauderdale city, and Pembroke Pines city and 22 other communities sit under NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2,3). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 17% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
